text: Ironvale Athletic regains possession deep in their defensive half on the right side with Jonah Lindqvist winning the ball. He passes backward to Teo Quinlan, who carries forward toward midfield on the right flank. Quinlan then plays a short pass back to Lindqvist near the final third, and Lindqvist sends a through ball into the penalty area. Oskar Lindgren breaks through centrally, just inside the box around 4.6 metres from goal, and shoots with his foot. The effort is strong but saved by the goalkeeper, denying a close-range chance.
